input: Order custom return address stamps for envelopes

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The exact text to be stamped (name, street, city, state, zip) must be confirmed before ordering — missing or wrong lines will make the stamp unusable.
Whether this is for personal, household, or business use changes the name format, branding expectations, and possibly the quantity needed.
Stamp style (self-inking, pre-inked, or traditional rubber with a separate ink pad) affects cost, convenience, and longevity — a key product decision.
Design preferences (font style, layout, decorative elements, ink colour) determine which vendors or templates to target.
Budget per stamp sets the tier of vendor and product quality to consider — options range from a few dollars to $30+.
The volume of envelopes stamped per week or month determines how many stamps to order and whether a premium self-inking model is worth the cost.
Whether the stamp needs to arrive by a specific date (e.g., ahead of a mailing event or wedding) changes how urgently to act and which vendors offer fast enough shipping.

gold.taskTitle: Order custom return address stamps for envelopes
gold.taskDescription: Research and place an order for personalised return address stamps to use on outgoing envelopes.

questions.title: What full address text should appear on the stamp?
questions.description: Confirm every line of text to be stamped: name(s), street address, city, state, and ZIP code.

questions.title: Is this stamp for personal, household, or business use?
questions.description: Clarify who the stamp is for to determine the correct name format and branding expectations.

questions.title: Do you prefer self-inking, pre-inked, or a traditional rubber stamp?
questions.description: Identify the stamp mechanism, as this is the primary product-type decision affecting cost and convenience.

questions.title: What font style, layout, or design look do you want?
questions.description: Establish design preferences such as classic, modern, or script fonts, ink colour, and any decorative border or motif.

questions.title: What is your budget per stamp?
questions.description: Set a spending ceiling to narrow down vendor and product quality tiers appropriately.

questions.title: How often do you plan to use the stamp each week?
questions.description: Gauge mailing frequency to determine whether a high-volume self-inking model is justified and how many stamps to order.

questions.title: Do you need the stamp delivered by a specific date?
questions.description: Identify any deadline (e.g., wedding invitations, a scheduled mailing) that would require expedited production or shipping.
